sanitization: Infrastructure identities/locators redacted or aliased; selected synthetic business facts preserved

received_bytes.sampling: 60 seconds per descriptor; counter aggregates over time by sum

consumer_lag.interpretation: CLI returned empty list; manual assign consumers do not expose group lag; no metric absence means zero

data.aggregation_policy: Descriptor COUNTER_INT64 / GAUGE_INT64; omit agg so server selects metric-specific function; counter time sum, gauge time average. Spatial lag aggregation not measured.
data.blocker: No usable resource-management-scoped Metrics API credential in authorized local environment or accessible key inventory. No key/role created and no CLI token extracted.
